new.n: St. Paul bank loot rumored buried on the Eliza Wilson farm, Elk Creek
new.pl: Town of Union (Eau Claire Co.), between the Elk Creek crossing and dam and the N part of the E. T. Wilson tract, W fractional NW¼ sec 19 T27N R10W
new.v: St. Paul bank loot (amount not given)
new.st: In April 1925 jailed burglars passed a tip, through ex-sheriff Garman, that loot from a St. Paul bank was buried on the old Eliza Wilson farm by Elk Creek. A 100-ft trench was dug at night in April 1925, possibly removing it. Part of the old homestead may now be under Elk Creek Lake, formed by the 1925 dam.
new.t: Tip from jailed burglars via ex-sheriff Garman, 1925; a 100-ft trench was dug at night in Apr 1925, possibly removing it; part of the old homestead may be under Elk Creek Lake (1925 dam). Private farmland: ask permission; the dam and lake shore may be public or utility land, so check before going.
acc: Private farmland: ask permission first. Dam and lake shore may be public or utility land.
